oliver: Rolling v3.1.0-canary into pool-B now (08:43 UTC). Quick smoke: kv-prefill, heartbeat, embed-synth, reranker. tagging @deploy-bot to run canary-small.

deploy-bot: started smoke-suite (canary-small) for v3.1.0-canary. probes: kv-prefill,http-heartbeat,embed-synth,reranker. ETA ~2m.

sam: Decision rules in thread: fail if embed-synth p95 > 220ms OR reranker error-rate >0.5% OR sustained region 5xx >0.4% for >60s.

sre-oncall: early feed — embed-synth tail in us-west-2 climbing, current p95 ~245ms, 502s at 0.7% for last 45s. routing looks steady. raising a quick alert.

deploy-bot: smoke-suite results:
- kv-prefill: OK (p95 37ms)
- http-heartbeat: OK
- reranker: OK (err 0.08%)
- embed-synth: ANOMALY (us-west-2) p95=249ms, 5xx=0.74%
Marking pool-B status: PARTIAL_FAIL.

mei: Can we isolate us-west-2 only? Avoid full rollback if global green. Options: pin region, throttle traffic, or targeted rollback. I prefer targeted rollback for us-west-2 and run extended embed sweep there.

oliver: Agreed. Execute targeted rollback for us-west-2 to v3.0.9 and pin. Also request quant/profile dump for failing pods.

/command
```
/deploy pin inference --region us-west-2 --to-version v3.0.9 --reason "embed-synth tail in us-west-2"
/deploy rollback inference --region us-west-2 --to-version v3.0.9 --reason "targeted rollback after embed-synth anomaly"
```

deploy-bot: Pin + targeted rollback initiated by oliver at 08:46 UTC. Rolling back us-west-2 pool -> v3.0.9. ETA ~50s. Will auto-run post-rollback embed-synth extended (5m) in us-west-2.

sre-oncall: INC-2026-640 created: embed-synth-usw2-tail. Collecting traces, quant-profile, kernel selection logs. Noting host mix: some genA + genB GPUs on the pool.

deploy-bot: Post-rollback probes (us-west-2): embed-synth p95=42ms, 5xx=0.0%. us-west-2 status: PASS. Global quick smoke re-run: all probes OK. Canary overall: PASS (us-west-2 pinned to v3.0.9).

mei: Good. Follow-ups: 1) reproduce worst-case locally with quant-v2 profile used in v3.1.0-canary, 2) run extended canary with traffic ramp paused for 30m, 3) add temp alert rule: embed-synth p95 delta >75ms within 3m.

sam: I'll add a line in release notes: "Targeted rollback in us-west-2 due to embed-synth tail spike; pool pinned; investigation ongoing." Leaving thread open for traces. :white_check_mark:
